To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Ts1Rher trisomy mice have increased skin tumor incidence and hyper-proliferating skin tumors compared to euploid littermates.
Ts1RHR mice develop more skin tumors in a chemical carcinogenesis model and that this is likely due to increased hyper-proliferative response to TPA.
Ts1Rher mice develop more papillomas in a DMBA-TPA chemical carcinogenesis paradigm, and these papillomas are hyper-proliferative and hyperkeratotic compared to euploid mice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of a genetic disorder, DS, which is characterized by the presence of trisomy 21 (3 copies of Hsa21).
the study of the molecular mechanisms of tumorigeniss in a mouse model of Down Syndrome.
the study of the genetic basis of cancer and aging, using mouse models and cell culture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the increased tumor incidence in Ts1RHR mice is likely due to the increased proliferation of keratinocytes.
Ts1Rher trisomy is a genetic predisposition to develop skin papillomas in response to DMBA-TPAs.
the Ts1Rhr mouse model of DS displays increased skin tumor incidence and keratinocyte hyper-proliferative potential in response to a TPA treatment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

trisomy of Hsa21 in keratinocytes leads to a hyper-proliferative phenotype that may be a result of altered gene expression in a subset of genes, including several disomic genes, that are involved in proliferation signalling.
trisomic keratocytes are hyper-proliferative in response to TPA.
trisomy of Hsa21 causes hyperkeratosis and keratinocyte hyperproliferative responses to TPA, which may be a result of altered expression of several genes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
trisomic mice are not completely protected from tumorigenesis.
people with DS may be more prone to develop skin tumors.
the tumor repression phenotype is not absolute and that trisomy may have the potential to cause cancer.
